content:
Some of my recent work uses social media data, natural language processing and AI models to study gender inequalities in digital spaces: from violence against women in leadership positions to the digital strategies of feminist movements.

-De los Santos, Daniela, Martin, Guillermina, Urriola, Ivonne & Voria, Andrea (2025). ‘Entre el menosprecio y las amenazas: análisis de violencia digital contra las mujeres en ocho países de Iberoamérica’. UNDP-LAC – Policy Notes 38. Read it here.

-Llanos, Beatriz, De los Santos, Daniela & Incio, José (2023). ‘Mujeres en movimiento(s): el poder del activismo, la incidencia y las estrategias digitales para impulsar transformaciones’. Atenea. UNDP, UN Women and International IDEA. Read the report here.

You can also explore a related exercise, developed during my MSc, that uses NLP models (BERT, LSTM, RNN) to classify stances in tweets about abortion, atheism, feminism and climate: code available here.
title: Gender, digital spaces and AI

content:
In the framework of my labor market research, I have published a few papers regarding the ‘future of work’ dilemma: new ways of organizing labor (such as telework, electronic commerce and gig economy), the dynamics of automatization and the labor market, and the gender impacts of these phenomena. You can also explore dissemination activities and press appearences about this subject in my resume.

-De los Santos, Daniela & Fynn, Inés (2024). ‘From Safety Net to Safety Trap: Informality and Telework During the Coronavirus Pandemic in Latin America’. American Behavioral Scientist, 68(8), 1032-1051. Read it here (open access version here).

-De los Santos, Daniela & Fernández, Mayra (2021). ‘Comercio electrónico y género en Uruguay: transformaciones recientes y la mirada hacia la post-pandemia.’ CIEDUR - Gender and Commerce Network. Read the report here.

-Fernández, Mayra & De los Santos, Daniela (2021). ‘Encuesta a personas dueñas de emprendimientos que funcionan a través del comercio electrónico.’ CIEDUR - Gender and Commerce Network. Explore it here.

-De los Santos, Daniela (2020). ‘Encuesta a Mujeres Empresarias.’ CIEDUR - Uruguayan Chamber of Commerce. Survey on female-led businesses in Uruguay. Read the report here.

-Espino, Alma & De los Santos, Daniela (2019). ‘Futuro del trabajo en Uruguay. La visión de los actores del mundo laboral y social’. Revista MERCOSUR de políticas sociales, 3, 69-84. Read more here.

-De los Santos, Daniela (2019). ‘El futuro del trabajo. Una perspectiva para Uruguay.’ Article in Academic Blog Va de Nuevo. Read it here.
